method: Direct inspection of actual published-art sources at 640x440 plus side-by-side real-animal reference examples for tiger, puma and lion; no pixel overlap metric is treated as anatomical accuracy.
disclaimer: Provisional editorial triage, not a certified zoological validation. 'provisional' means no obvious category mismatch in this pass, not fully verified anatomy.
